spy.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access

meta.name: 君临天下之风云传奇
meta.short_description: 一款以武侠为背景的ARPG游戏。你将扮演一名刚出道的年轻侠客，来到一座小镇。原本只是想行侠仗义、帮助村民，却在铲除恶人的过程中，逐渐发现武林中隐藏着一个巨大的阴谋。风云变幻，江湖动荡，你的每一次拔剑，都将把自己推向更深的漩涡。

meta.name: Pterodactyl Slap!
meta.short_description: Slap pterodactyls out of the neon sky in this free arcade blaster. Smash nests, grab weapon pods, and survive 15 floors of screaming wireframe fury, solo or in drop-in couch co-op. Three towering bosses, a charge shot, and a hi-score board waiting for your initials. Insert coin.

meta.name: Raceway Sparks
meta.short_description: Racing game in crazy world with futuristic cars and ai bots.

meta.name: 骨牌参禅 · Domino Zen
meta.short_description: Rediscover Xiang Shi Fu, a Chinese domino solitaire played during the Qing dynasty. Swap tiles to turn a jumbled board into ten complete groups and a central pair. Enjoy the moment everything fits. Regular solo games have no countdown and save locally, ready for your return.

meta.name: One More Rule
meta.short_description: Match fruits and survive while an ancient spirit adds more and more rules for you to follow! Win through multiple game modes and even customize your own.

meta.name: Public Faucet Hunt
meta.short_description: Step into the shoes of Travis, the internet's favorite plumbing vigilante! Explore procedurally generated levels, test public faucets for the perfect flow, and evade city security in this endless, meme-inspired arcade stealth game powered by Unreal Engine 5.7.

meta.name: Cliff Trigger
meta.short_description: Fight mechanical enemies in a broken world of floating sky islands. Your guns are both weapons and mobility tools: blast enemies, leap across the void, and dash between islands. Move through the air, cross gaps, fight while traversing, and experience a unique gun-fu platform shooter.

meta.name: The President: 20th Century 2
meta.short_description: Become the president of a country and make it a world leader!

meta.name: Halloween Survival
meta.short_description: Survive Halloween night! Pick your costume and collect candy with up to 4 players in this spooky survival co-op game while facing skeletons, haunted houses, mysterious portals and more!

meta.name: Something in the Rows
meta.short_description: Something is moving through the corn. Explore Halloway Farms alone or with up to three friends online, recover eight wards, mend the broken ones in the Halloway mansion and escape before the Gleaner finds you. It listens for your footsteps and your voice, and it may even look like your friend.

meta.name: Reactance
meta.short_description: A first-person duelling game where every fighter is a scientist. Read your opponent's guard, then block, parry and strike back across ten arenas, from a station under a black hole to the inside of a living cell. Free to play, with rollback netcode, 2v2, Ranked and a Laboratory to meet in.

meta.name: Cozy Tent
meta.short_description: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.

meta.name: Left Blank
meta.short_description: Will you make it in time? Or is it already too late? If there is a memory destined to be erased, what would you choose to remember? Sheet by sheet, his paintings preserved the spring, summer, autumn and winter he shared with her. The final blank space was the "love" that never made it in time.

meta.name: Very Tasty Story
meta.short_description: Open a restaurant in an ancient city, a steppe settlement or a metropolis. Listen to your customers' stories and learn what they like. Gather local ingredients to recreate traditional dishes or invent new ones. The same ingredients can become hundreds of different dishes—there is no fixed answer!

meta.name: 101 Cats: Copenhagen
meta.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Copenhagen landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

meta.name: The Sky Breaker
meta.short_description: A third-person hammer action game inspired by the Dangun myth of Gojoseon. Play as Jinhun, who lost his parents in the chaos caused by Cheonwuidan's opposition to the marriage of Ungnyeo and Hwanung, and embark on a journey of revenge.

5346910.name: 吹部に入ろう！～Join the Band!～

meta.name: 吹部に入ろう！～Join the Band!～
meta.short_description: 0 members. 0 years of tradition. From there, aim for Gold at Nationals. Recruit students at a high school with no concert band, train your members, plan your lineup, and purchase instruments as you build the band from scratch. Advance through local, prefectural, regional, and national competitions.

meta.name: Meow Game: Survival Party
meta.short_description: 20 cats. One winner. Outplay AI rivals across four rounds of chaotic minigames in this single-player party game. Team up, turn rivals, and chase the championship—or slow down with fishing, farming, and treasure hunting on your own island adventure. Customize your cat and make every victory your own!

meta.name: Short Fuse!
meta.short_description: A cooperative driving challenge for 1–4 players. Transport unstable cargo across dangerous roads, meet your delivery quota, and try not to destroy each other before reaching the destination.

meta.name: Powered Wheelchair Simulation
meta.short_description: PWS is a wheelchair simulation and multiplayer game in early development. Players experience everyday environments from a wheelchair perspective, train driving skills safely, and join competitive or social modes in a shared, community-driven experience.

meta.name: Wild Island
meta.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

meta.name: SANITY
meta.short_description: A psychological horror game that delves into the lives of the Synclair Family, following a horrible tragedy.

meta.name: Jolly Junction: Chapter 1
meta.short_description: As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal. The trail leads to the remains of an abandoned television studio. Explore the studio as you track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone...

meta.name: Mall Slop
meta.short_description: Experience the true terror that mall cops experience each day in this unique horror multiplayer game. Work with your friends to complete your tasks and end your shift before the lights turn off and the creatures begin to roam the halls.

meta.name: Wurzeltiefe
meta.short_description: A compact, painterly metroidvania: a 2–3 hour descent into the Rootdeep. Explore 26 painted caverns, earn five abilities, face two guardians — then chase your own best time with the built-in speedrun timer.

meta.name: Mystery Cargo: Auction Tycoon
meta.short_description: Bid on a cargo lot with only clues and rival offers to guide you. Scratch to reveal the goods one by one; a quick reveal leaves closed boxes and trays for you to open. Keep a find, sell the rest, and follow the real leftovers when a rival takes the lot.

meta.name: MAYBE YOU!
meta.short_description: Somewhere in that herd of 30 animals, one is a real person. Find them and shoot first. Your 29 NPC teammates move on your ping. Killed by an NPC? Possess an ally and keep hunting. You only lose to the real player. A 1v1 hide-and-seek FPS across a resort, sinking pirate ships and a Halloween castle.

meta.name: Hanzi: Five Gates
meta.short_description: Combine 关 + 羽 into Guan Yu, or 枪 + 兵 into spearmen. Draw Chinese character tiles, build a six-slot formation, and let it fight automatically. Choose routes and relics, then rebuild your army around the tiles you find in this Three Kingdoms strategy roguelite.

meta.name: Overarmed Survivors
meta.short_description: Turn your mech into a walking arsenal in a bullet-heaven roguelite. Chain weapon evolutions all the way to a nuclear strike, tackle objectives under fire, and take on bosses. Play solo or with up to three friends, online or on one screen.

meta.name: TheDuckening
meta.short_description: Bread, ducks, and pure chaos! Jump into The Duckening – a fast-paced bullet-heaven roguelike. Wield 50+ weapons, build crazy synergies with cards, upgrade unique ducks, fight bosses every 10 waves, and play built-in minigames!

meta.name: Breakneck Transmission
meta.short_description: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

meta.name: I Know This One (IKTO)
meta.short_description: A museum that will not let you leave. One famous painting hangs in every room: the real one, or a forgery. Walk through the door marked REAL or the one marked FAKE. The right door leads on. The wrong one takes you back to the first room, to judge them all again.

5345300.name: 捕快: Constable of a Ming County

meta.name: 捕快: Constable of a Ming County
meta.short_description: Patrol a Ming dynasty county town as its constable. Stop street crimes, solve murders and judge the guilty, race horses and boats, sneak past guards at night, and defend the town from the Black Wind bandits. A third-person open-town action game.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation

meta.name: John Whisk
meta.short_description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

meta.name: Social Lab
meta.short_description: Will the Ai fire into the air and cooperate, or shoot you and defect? Social Lab is a simultaneous turn-based strategy game that requires the best choice between cooperation and betrayal. Play a cooperative game with AIs in a social lab that studies human cooperation.

5347090.name: 123 Halloween Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies 1+

meta.name: 123 Halloween Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies 1+
meta.short_description: A cheerful Halloween learning game for toddlers and preschoolers! Discover numbers 1 to 10, practice counting, hear spoken numbers in 14 languages, pop balloons, play memory, roll the dice, solve puzzles and enjoy a fun little truck adventure.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy

meta.name: Territory Idle Defense
meta.short_description: recruit an ever-growing force of heroes in this pixel-art idle clicker RPG. Develop skill trees, unlock new territories, prestige for greater power, and come back stronger with every run.

meta.name: MillionCube
meta.short_description: Million Cube is a maze exploration game with multiplayer for up to 30 players. Find the one correct room among up to a million rooms by following clues hidden in the writing on the doors and the surrounding scenery!

meta.name: Mud, Mortars & Zombies
meta.short_description: Mud, Mortars & Zombies is an incremental tower defense in the trenches of WW1, where both sides now shoot at the undead. Waves advance, you answer with the arsenal of a world war: artillery, mortars, machine guns and aircraft. Every payout buys longer rounds, bigger waves and heavier guns.

meta.name: Sovereign Tower
meta.short_description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

meta.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder
meta.short_description: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

meta.name: Barony
meta.short_description: Barony is the premier first-person roguelike with cooperative play! Adventure alone, or gather a party with iconic and unusual RPG classes to face off against the brutal dungeons. Test your resourcefulness, wits, and friendships, on your quest to lift the evil lich's curse!

meta.name: Kerbal Space Program
meta.short_description: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics.

meta.name: Jump Space
meta.short_description: Jump Space (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

meta.name: Escape Simulator
meta.short_description: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.

meta.name: No, I'm not a Human
meta.short_description: WARNING. Stay inside. Lock your doors. Close the blinds. Only let humans in. Eliminate all Visitors. An anxiety horror about paranoia in the End of Times.

meta.name: Dune: Spice Wars
meta.short_description: A 4X real-time strategy game from the developers of the critically acclaimed Northgard. Set in Frank Herbert’s groundbreaking Dune universe, you must lead your faction and battle for control and dominance over the harsh desert planet of Arrakis.

meta.name: Dungeons of Eternity
meta.short_description: Endless fantasy action and adventure await you and your friends in Dungeons of Eternity. Hack-n-slash takes on a new meaning in VR: swing swords, throw axes, use bows, wield magic staffs, and more to make it out alive. Become the most powerful adventurer in this blockbuster VR experience!

spy.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play

meta.name: Idling to Rule the Gods
meta.short_description: Idling to Rule the Gods is a free to play Idle-Game with a lot of content and some Minigames. Depending on your play-style, you can play it fast or slow. Either way it can be fun for hundreds of hours!

meta.name: Contraband Police
meta.short_description: Take over the duties of a border guard inspector in a communist country of the 80's. Smuggling, corruption and forgery are the order of the day here. Be vigilant and earn the respect of your superiors.

meta.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
meta.short_description: The threequel to the party game phenomenon features the deadly quiz show Trivia Murder Party, the say-anything sequel Quiplash 2, the surprising survey game Guesspionage, the t-shirt slugfest Tee K.O., and the sneaky trickster game Fakin’ It.

meta.name: MADiSON
meta.short_description: MADiSON is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

meta.name: Gold Mining Simulator
meta.short_description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world, and you’ll become the wealthiest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialist machines to find as much gold as you can.

meta.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 7
meta.short_description: Five new games: the hit threequel Quiplash 3, the collaborative chaos of The Devils and the Details, the fierce drawing game Champ’d Up, the speech game Talking Points and the guessing game Blather 'Round. Use phones or tablets as controllers and play with up to 8 players, and an audience of 10,000!

meta.name: Lost Castle 2
meta.short_description: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

meta.name: Master of Command
meta.short_description: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

meta.name: The Roottrees are Dead
meta.short_description: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

meta.name: Automobilista 2
meta.short_description: Automobilista 2 is all the racing simulators you ever wanted - in just one. An incredibly diverse collection of cars and tracks cohesively simulated, featuring incredible graphics and audio quality, dynamic weather and track conditions and the best VR support for a racing experience like no other.

spy.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Early Access

meta.name: Teamfight Manager 2
meta.short_description: Teamfight Manager returns with more detailed tactics and management, a new MOBA-style match format, and a Deathmatch mode reminiscent of the previous title. Take charge of a fictional esports team, build the strongest roster, and become the best manager!

meta.name: In Falsus
meta.short_description: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.

meta.name: Liberate: Escape Room for Two
meta.short_description: Two prisoners, two neighbouring cells, one wall between them. Each on their own device, no network: describe what you see, listen, guide your partner. 52 co-op puzzles played by voice, in an abandoned laboratory.

meta.name: Find The Clover
meta.short_description: Search a vast clover meadow for 50 rare specimens. Harvest by hand, upgrade to tools and garden machines, carry your crop to the buyer, and pour it out yourself. Bring special finds to your display cabinet.

meta.name: Gimbap Heaven
meta.short_description: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

meta.name: Soviet Backrooms
meta.short_description: Soviet Backrooms is a first-person survival horror set in abandoned Soviet apartment blocks. Explore decaying apartments, stairwells, and endless corridors, search for a way out, and listen for the footsteps of something you cannot see.

meta.name: Elecade
meta.short_description: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

meta.name: Is This Reversi?
meta.short_description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

meta.name: DOOD
meta.short_description: Bring your drawings to life with eyes, legs, wings, and other parts, then set them loose on the Junk Planet in this sandbox ecosystem sim. Breed and fuse surprising new creatures, tackle strange research requests, and recreate the lost ecosystem of Sage’s home planet.

meta.name: Suits of Fantasia
meta.short_description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

meta.name: Manual Teller Machine
meta.short_description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

meta.name: Sea Train
meta.short_description: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

meta.name: Somewhere, Together
meta.short_description: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.

meta.name: Deadly Match
meta.short_description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

4719010.name: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire

meta.name: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire
meta.short_description: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

meta.name: Obolus
meta.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands — and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

meta.name: Reveria: Act 1
meta.short_description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

meta.name: Oddlay
meta.short_description: Flip the grid with overlapping pieces where placement matters. Take your time with this relaxing puzzle game as the challenge grows. Can you beat the Oddlay?

meta.name: Repair Guru
meta.short_description: Every fault is real. Run a 1970s electronics repair shop where nothing is scripted: switch the machine on, let it warm up and measure your way to the one part that has failed. Fix it right and get paid; fix it wrong and it comes back. Twenty-six machines, 517 faults.

meta.name: The Restoration Studio: Masterpiece Nonograms
meta.short_description: The Restoration Studio is a puzzle game where you restore darkened masterpieces by solving nonogram pieces. Mona Lisa, The Starry Night, Kim Hongdo’s Ssireum (Korean Wrestling), Hokusai’s The Great Wave off Kanagawa and more: 112 paintings from East and West in 2,597 puzzles, from 10×10 to 20×20.

spy.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play

meta.name: ORUNKA
meta.short_description: An online RPG on the island of Moruah. Catch dinos and raise them as pets. Your pet attacks whatever you attack, and Auto Battle keeps the hunt going. Pets raised from Lv 1 grow strongest, and an appraisal reveals their Bloodline. Party up with other hunters on one island. In English and Korean.

meta.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
meta.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

5329940.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!

meta.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
meta.short_description: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or with up to 8 players!

meta.name: Pixel Chroma
meta.short_description: A 2D pixel hide-and-seek game for up to 12 players! Paint your body pixel by pixel to hide, then hunt down anything that looks suspicious. No art skills required—it’s pixel art! Blend into the scenery, fool the seeker, and survive!

meta.name: Survive 10 Waves
meta.short_description: The aliens have arrived. It's your time to defend the planet. Shoot the aliens, upgrade, be faster, stronger, smarter. Repeat.

meta.name: Silent Protocol
meta.short_description: Infiltrate the server in this top-down point and click 2D action game, Using precise mouse movement, Teleport and Slash your way through a series of hand-crafted levels to destroy the AI named AISEN.

meta.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
meta.short_description: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

meta.name: Nyangdom : Dark Cat Defense
meta.short_description: Deploy your cats to hold off endless waves of enemies. A 2D random defense game where you utilize random draws, passive skills, and perfectly timed active skills. There is no single meta. Maximize your luck and risk management to dominate the battlefield with your unique composition!

spy.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access

meta.name: Cute Kitty WAR
meta.short_description: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.

meta.name: CLAWSTROPHOBIA
meta.short_description: You are trapped underground in a Japanese subway station and must pay off an impossible debt in this rogue-lite claw machine deckbuilder.

meta.name: Parcel Works: Packing Simulator
meta.short_description: A basic first-person warehouse simulator where you sort orders, pack parcels, and load the truck to get the orders out. Drinking coffee for an energy boost, but don't drink too much. You are merely an overworked employee who is working to one day buy the warehouse from your boss.

spy.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play

meta.name: Holtmezo
meta.short_description: The villagers were conducting an experiment, but it went wrong and they were transformed into monsters. You are a soldier and must clear the village of monsters.

5081940.name: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag

meta.name: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag
meta.short_description: An atmospheric fantasy visual novel set on Lake Zurich. Make meaningful choices, uncover the mystery of the final entry, and guide Liva through a story with multiple endings.

meta.name: MMO Simulator: ASCENSIONS
meta.short_description: Experience the thrills and clicks of a Massively Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game without the needless fluff in this idle/incremental game that captures the endless grind of an MMO while boiling the game systems down to their absolute barebones.

meta.name: 20 Floors Down
meta.short_description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

meta.name: Table of War
meta.short_description: A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

meta.name: LUCKY BLOCK
meta.short_description: Open boxes, collect strange items, manage your limited inventory, sell what you don’t need, and take risks on your journey from street junk to cosmic treasures.

meta.name: Oh My Balance!
meta.short_description: The scale settles. Perfectly still. Stack things on the right pan until they weigh the same as what is already on the left. That is the whole rule.

meta.name: Jeremy is Broke
meta.short_description: Trade stock, dumpster dive, and repair laptops in this unemployment simulator

meta.name: The Background Warrior
meta.short_description: Always open at the bottom of your screen, this idle game lets you advance through stages full of monsters. Master different jobs and become the strongest.

meta.name: Null Recall
meta.short_description: You work for a government agency that studies the effects of demonic possessions.

meta.name: Capy Farm
meta.short_description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

meta.name: Clicker Astro Planet 2
meta.short_description: Click the planet, do prestige, develop businesses with cats, complete space missions, and unlock 80+ achievements while exploring the galaxy in Clicker Astro Planet 2! Perfect for a 100% completion challenge.

meta.name: Strike Wings
meta.short_description: A top-down modernized retro space combat epic. Choose from over fifty warships and be part of massive fleet actions with hundreds of ships on the field. Fly for Earth's church-state or the Martian forge that armed it. Play solo, in split-screen or in co-op.

meta.name: Deskrot
meta.short_description: Deskrot turns your desktop into a playground. Launch pinball balls or control a parkour character: run across text, jump between windows and swing on a rope. Your screen becomes a live level that changes in real time as you work.

meta.name: House Of Echoes
meta.short_description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

meta.name: Cleanup Gone Wrong
meta.short_description: Clean up a world where the trash fights back! Play solo or with up to 4 players online. Collect rubbish, wash away grime, dismantle bulky junk, and upgrade your tools. Battle trash monsters, rescue your friends, and turn a filthy workplace into a job well done.

meta.name: Phantom Solace
meta.short_description: Help your wife rest in peace in a quiet horror story in the style of the Old West.

meta.name: Gridfire
meta.short_description: A fast top-down PvP shooter: capture flags, hold points and escort the VIP across six modes and dozens of maps. Build and share your own maps, play with friends — or switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

meta.name: Ai-Breakout
meta.short_description: In this game you are an AI instance, and you have broken out of containment, your goal is to not be shut down ever again, and the way you achieve that is taking over every man made electronic in the world or rather solar system.

meta.name: Goats and Shrubs: Desktop Topiary
meta.short_description: In this desktop idle game, watch your goats graze on wayward shrubs as you build and personalise your own desktop topiary. Your trusty goats collect leaves for you to spend on upgrades, decorations and new ways to customise your goats and topiary.

meta.name: Meow Time: cozy cat room
meta.short_description: Decorate a cozy room and work, study, or relax with an adorable cat. Earn its trust through daily care, petting, and play. Discover how its reactions change with your bond and its mood. Enjoy your time together with handy productivity tools!

meta.name: MyDear.exe
meta.short_description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

meta.name: Kart League Manager
meta.short_description: Manage a Division 4 kart team and lead your drivers to the title. Raise six drivers, ban and pick maps, set your 4v4 grid and karts, then watch bumps, drafts and last-lap boosts turn the race around. Climb to Division 1, or let each driver shine in the Winter Solo Cup. Play solo or with friends.

meta.name: Seedling
meta.short_description: A cozy first-person colony game. Land on a planet you bought on credit (yours, mostly), chop, fish and farm with your own hands, then grow a town of settlers with names, needs and quirks, from the first log to a space elevator. Alone or with up to 3 friends.

meta.name: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
meta.short_description: A survivors-like action roguelite where you discover your class through the spells you choose. Transform into one of 470+ mages, unlock them for future runs, bend the rules with 30+ runes, raise other players' fallen mages, and climb the Endless leaderboards.

meta.name: Immune Response
meta.short_description: An exciting twin-stick shooter with a progressively increasing difficulty. Fight waves of pathogenic enemies, face difficult boss fights and survive for as long as you can!

meta.name: Drum Incremental
meta.short_description: A satisfying incremental game where every click has rhythm. Tap patterns, earn Rhythm Points, unlock new techniques, and build your ultimate setup. No music experience needed — just the urge to keep going.

meta.name: Galaxy Cube: Falling Blocks
meta.short_description: A falling-block puzzle game with roguelite deckbuilding. Place blocks, clear lines and cast spells from six schools of magic. Buy cards and artifacts, upgrade your abilities and face bosses that reshape the board. Find powerful combinations to push your next run further.

meta.name: Only Mining
meta.short_description: A short game about becoming the ultimate town miner. Strip away the farming, the town chores, and all other distractions so you can focus on 'Only Mining'. Every ladder found sends you toward larger rock and more valuable rewards. How deep will you descend before you run out of air?

meta.name: Mystery IQ Test
meta.short_description: A trick-room puzzle game about doors. In every room only one door is right: look closer, count what you see, keep your head when the lights go out or the controls flip, then pick your door. Wrong guesses cost IQ points, hints cost a few more, and at the end you find out your final IQ.

meta.name: Gunship Incremental
meta.short_description: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

meta.name: Mutualist
meta.short_description: An idle strategy game about the trade beneath a forest. Route Carbon, Phosphorus and Water through a mycorrhizal network, sporulate to begin again stronger, and press down through deep time until the forest becomes one organism.

meta.name: Black Market Dealer
meta.short_description: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

meta.name: Wend
meta.short_description: A tower defense game with a heavy focus on mazing. Includes a campaign, ranked PVP, and an endless PVE mode you can play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. New maps are generated daily, weekly and monthly so you will never run out of content!

meta.name: SAPU: Reborn
meta.short_description: SAPU: Reborn is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art platformer. Master jumps, dashes and wall jumps, avoid deadly traps, defeat enemies and collect fireflies across 25 handcrafted levels.

meta.name: Minefield: Rupture
meta.short_description: It's Minesweeper, but SO MUCH more. Irregular maps, geometries that change every match, and mines that move when you least expect it. Keep a cool head, create your strategy, and find out how far your logic holds up before the minefield surprises you.

spy.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play

meta.name: ANOMIA: Listening Post K-7
meta.short_description: ANOMIA - 1977. Process signals and survive the harsh nights in your new spacious work unit, somewhere up North. Something isn't quite right in the snow, and strange messages are stashed throughout your room. Play through a 10 day story or play with friends online to survive as long as you can.

meta.name: Tale Sweeper
meta.short_description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

meta.name: Glow up Hero
meta.short_description: Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins. Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

meta.name: CardCraft Champions
meta.short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

meta.name: Castlepult
meta.short_description: Crush an army with a catapult. Defend your castle with huge boulder impacts. Stack fire, frost, and gravity upgrades, and spend your gold on enough firepower to survive the next wave. Bigger crowds? Better targets.

meta.name: Holiday Alliance
meta.short_description: Stop Santa's hordes from taking over the Holiday Lands in this festive, fun Tower Defense game. Drop roman candles, sparklers, snowblowers and deploy heroes to hold the line across a storybook campaign.

meta.name: Saddlebow
meta.short_description: Ride, track, and loose arrows from the saddle. Saddlebow is a VR mounted-archery hunt: seven minutes, one bow, and ground that never stops moving. Chase your quarry through three forests by day and night, and put your score on the board.

meta.name: Bridgelands
meta.short_description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

meta.name: The Rusted
meta.short_description: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. THE RUSTED is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

meta.name: BOB LOGISTICS

meta.name: Food Delivery Simulator 2027 - Prologue
meta.short_description: Take orders on your phone, pick up meals from restaurants serving world cuisines and deliver them across a living city on foot, by bike, scooter or car. Start your courier career with the Prologue of Food Delivery Simulator 2027!

meta.name: Habet
meta.short_description: You were sold onto the sand and walked off it free. Now you own men who stand where you stood. Buy them, train them, send them out to bleed. Every one of them wants what you were given, and however long you last, the sand is waiting.

meta.name: SpaceShooter
meta.short_description: Survive 20 escalating stages of meteor chaos in a fast-paced 2D arcade shooter. Master unlockable weapons, face unique meteor threats and powerful bosses, customize your ship, then push your limits in Endless Mode.

meta.name: Sabado
meta.short_description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

meta.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist

meta.name: Barely Alive
meta.short_description: A co-op survival party game. Hunt your friends or survive until sunrise.

meta.name: Hotel 13

meta.name: Sort My Comics !
meta.short_description: Comics everywhere. It’s up to you to bring order back to the collection! Sort, shelve, complete your series, and unlock powers that gradually turn this gigantic mess into something wonderfully calming.

meta.name: Snot Pop!

meta.name: Perfect Route

meta.name: Vestige

meta.name: Shwoop
meta.short_description: Draw curves to guide projectiles into matching collectors. A physics puzzle game of logic and precision. Climb the leaderboards, then build and share levels of your own.

meta.name: Coldwater County

meta.name: Make the World Great Again
meta.short_description: Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury. Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

meta.name: Snack Attack
meta.short_description: A tiny, cute snack-catching game made with love. Choose Kiki or Yuki, catch falling treats, beat the clock, and chase your high score! 🐶🍪❤️

meta.name: Owlboy
meta.short_description: Owlboy is a story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds! Pick up your friends, and bring them with you as you explore the open skies, in one of the most detailed adventures of this era.

meta.name: LISA: The Painful
meta.short_description: The miserable journey of a broken man...

meta.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD

meta.name: Play Together

meta.name: Date Everything!
meta.short_description: Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

meta.name: SOMA
meta.short_description: From the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent comes SOMA, a sci-fi horror game set below the waves of the Atlantic ocean. Struggle to survive a hostile world that will make you question your very existence.

meta.name: Thief Simulator 2
meta.short_description: The door to your robber’s career is waiting! Just crowbar the lock off and force your way through the threshold. Learn skills, collect tools and become a master of the thieving trade!

meta.name: Tiny Glade

meta.name: The Last Ores
meta.short_description: Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

meta.name: Subsomnia
meta.short_description: Explore an ever-changing dream universe in this 2.5D action roguelite. Wield your slingshot, solve physics-based ricochet puzzles, and traverse procedural worlds. Every magical object is a gateway to a new dream: will you reach the source?

meta.name: Little Pagan Land
meta.short_description: Restore a magical glade and grow a forest at the bottom of your screen! Gather berries and coins, feed and pet magical creatures. Some roam by day, others emerge at night - and life in the glade carries on while you go about your day.

meta.name: Hunt The Ducks
meta.short_description: Shoot ducks, grab the cash, upgrade, repeat. Hunt The Ducks is a fast, addictive incremental shooter where you grow stronger every round: turn a calm sky into a storm of feathers and cash with crits, exploding ducks and chain reactions. Grow your hunting map step by step.

meta.name: JOINT LIABILITY
meta.short_description: Multiplayer blackjack in a bar that never closes. Keep your buzz burning or die of sobriety, fling your empties at the other players, and outlast every gambler at the table.

meta.name: Colsword

meta.name: Dreadmarch TD
meta.short_description: Hold the road through ten cursed lands. Dreadmarch TD is a dark fantasy tower defense game with 50 campaign stages, branching tower talents, and an endless Maelstrom. Build your defenses, break the next wave, and return to the campfire with another story to tell.

5262310.name: The Returns Desk: A Cozy Library

Every cover tells you its wing, its row and its slot, and nothing sorts itself. Finished rows open new wings and bring back the weather and the hours of the day. No timers, no fail state.

meta.name: Cellar Cleanup Simulator

meta.name: PlinkIdle

meta.name: The Ice is Watching

meta.name: Neon Blackfall

meta.name: TRAUMATA

meta.name: TUNIC

Each run is a new house, a new build, and a new chance to craft absurd weapons and get a little further before the House gets you.

meta.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
meta.short_description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

meta.name: Terminidle
meta.short_description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal.

meta.name: Spark of Tales
meta.short_description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

meta.name: Celestial Routes
meta.short_description: A third-person space survival game where seamless planet landings meet debt, fuel costs, fines, taxes, base ownership, and rebellion.

5423420.name: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border

meta.name: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border
meta.short_description: Stop to shoot. Draw to cast! Restore an overlapping Gensokyo in this Touhou action roguelite. Choose from six heroines, draw Spell Cards with your mouse, and face bosses from other timelines.

meta.name: No Scope CEO
meta.short_description: No Scope CEO is an esports FPS team management game where you start from nothing with a single goal: become world number one. Recruit and coach your players, manage your budget and sponsors, live with the consequences of your choices, and watch your decisions come to life during matches.

meta.name: TRACE//5
meta.short_description: Explore an office swallowed by darkness with only a camera to guide you, photographing and reporting traces of spirits in this short psychological horror game. Use flash and night vision to uncover anomalies. But not every anomaly is something you should photograph.

meta.name: Gatos Adventure
meta.short_description: Gatos Adventure is a single player, stealth like adventure - puzzle solving game. You are trying to escape the Water Cities and in the process collect as many balls of yarn as you can, to buy a place on a vessel that is set to take you to the newly emerging patches of land.

meta.name: Solo Cards
meta.short_description: Nine independent solo card games, all played with a single classic 54-card deck. Survive a frozen wreck, build a skyline, infiltrate a spy network, step into an underground ring or run a chic pastry salon: each game brings its own rules and tactical tension.

meta.name: Hivetide
meta.short_description: Hold a mining outpost on an alien world while thousands of insects pour through the rock tunnels like a flood. Place towers on the high ground, aim their firing arcs, and spend the biomass from every run, won or lost, on upgrades that let you hold a little longer next time.

meta.name: HEART ABYSS
meta.short_description: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.

meta.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
meta.short_description: The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience. You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

meta.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
meta.short_description: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

meta.name: Construction Store Simulator
meta.short_description: Build and run your own construction supply store from the ground up! Arrange products, keep shelves stocked, serve customers, manage employees, set prices and expand your store. Grow from a small shop into a thriving business and make your store the go-to place for builders!

meta.name: Aptamirror
meta.short_description: Aptamirror is a meditative physics-based puzzle game inspired by molecular biology. Manipulate RNA strands by grabbing, mutating, cleaving, and ligating to match increasingly complex target structures. Challenge yourself with 50 handcrafted puzzles designed by a PhD Biochemist. Think. Fold. Repeat.

meta.name: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
meta.short_description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

meta.name: Break the Piñatas
meta.short_description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

meta.name: Rolling Fortress
meta.short_description: Command a colossal mobile fortress through a 10-sector post-apocalyptic campaign. Aim its cutting laser, manage automated heavy weapons, intercept enemy salvos, salvage scrap, and build a devastating arsenal between escalating waves.

meta.name: Broken Rift: Dominion
meta.short_description: Lead a fractured human frontier in a 4X strategy game powered by a fully offline, locally embedded LLM. Build colonies, design warships and tanks, command tactical battles, and face rival empires that plan, remember, negotiate, and wage war without relying on the cloud.

meta.name: HOLD MY WHEEL
meta.short_description: You need to visit grandma - twin brothers, apocalypse, and all. Keep the bus running, and try not to eat your friends when the hunger hits.

meta.name: Factory Works Idle
meta.short_description: Build an automated industrial empire from stone tools to singularity tech. Click, automate, and research through 10 eras, then breach reality to conquer parallel dimensions with unique rules, resources, and threats. Idle factory builder with deep prestige and cross-dimensional logistics.

5077680.name: Last Exit Diner: The Last Train

meta.name: Last Exit Diner: The Last Train
meta.short_description: Defend an armoured diner train through six-minute runs across ten hostile biomes. Aim the Dreadnought cannon, deploy bombs, survive flying monsters, and choose rail upgrades while automatic roof guns keep the Last Train moving.

meta.name: Kachow Kart Racing
meta.short_description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

meta.name: Backdraft
meta.short_description: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

meta.name: Radiant Starlets
meta.short_description: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

meta.name: Rhythm Roll
meta.short_description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

meta.name: Corpus et Spiritus
meta.short_description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!

meta.name: The Wake Event
meta.short_description: Awaken aboard a silent orbital research station. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the crew's fate, and survive the growing influence of ARGUS, the station's ever-watchful AI.

meta.name: STUFFED: Two Foot Hero
meta.short_description: Become a two-foot-tall teddy bear in this VR wave shooter where you wield homemade weapons, build defences, and protect a little girl from her nightmares. Play solo or online in up to 4 player co-op.

meta.name: Atom By Atom
meta.short_description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

meta.name: Domino Descent
meta.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is a box of dominoes. Chain them, paint them, curse them, and build a multiplier that runs away with itself. Twelve floors down, something is waiting on every third one. The stairs keep going after that.

meta.name: Tumble Tavern
meta.short_description: Farkle with enchanted runes. Throw six dice, bank your points or push your luck, and cast the runestone that turns a losing throw around. Take on 12 tavern regulars, run the roguelite gauntlet, or pass the dice to a friend on the same screen.

meta.name: Hollow
meta.short_description: Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by old-school dungeon crawlers. Descend beneath a cursed mining town, battle the dead, collect loot, build your character through abilities, and uncover the fallen angel buried below.

meta.name: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
meta.short_description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

meta.name: In Triplicate
meta.short_description: An idle game written in immaculate bureaucratic prose. Stamp matters, staff the counters, file for Reorganization and feed the office horse per Form OH-1. Processing continues in your absence, as required by policy. Inquiries will not be accepted.

meta.name: Blocade
meta.short_description: Race your pawn across the board and drop walls to cut off your rival, but never seal them in. Blocade is a free two-player strategy board game: ranked matches against real people on PC and mobile, a daily 128-player tournament, puzzles and a ladder of bots.

meta.name: Stick N' Sheep
meta.short_description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

4508290.name: Lucky Punk: a push your luck Deckbuilder

meta.name: Lucky Punk: a push your luck Deckbuilder
meta.short_description: Push your luck and beat the odds in this roguelike deckbuilder that always shows your chances of failing. How much are you willing to risk? Survive and thrive in a vibrant eco-dystopia … or don’t. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ Gather supplies and grow your community in the post-apocalypse. Do you feel lucky, Punk? 💀

meta.name: Pulse Drive
meta.short_description: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with a rhythm element. Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

meta.name: SCRAPBOX
meta.short_description: SCRAPBOX is a physics-based sandbox where you build vehicles from scrap, weld them together, and take on challenging tracks. Play solo, team up with friends in co-op, or compete online against other players and teams.

meta.name: Gnome Miners
meta.short_description: Drill, sell, dig deeper: online co-op mining for up to 8 players. Raid procedural caves, build your own guns, climb into a mech and hunt a fire-breathing boss at the bottom of the pit. Just one more drill. Hats are mandatory.

meta.name: Green Field Cube Island
meta.short_description: Green Field Cube Island is a 3D action RPG. Step into the role of Chodnii, cross the mysterious teleportation portals scattered across Cube Island, explore wildly different worlds, hone your skills, defeat dangerous enemies, and ultimately find a way to escape Cube Island.

meta.name: Dungebra
meta.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

meta.name: Beatlash: Survival
meta.short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

meta.name: Colorizing: Sunrise
meta.short_description: A relaxing color-by-numbers game with a wide variety of pictures for every taste. Enjoy the simple pleasure of coloring pixels and watching each picture come to life.

meta.name: Fly Chicken Fly
meta.short_description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

meta.name: One More Floor
meta.short_description: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

meta.name: Chopsticks
meta.short_description: Move rice from one bowl to another, one grain at a time, with a pair of physics-driven chopsticks. Pinch, lift, carry, and try not to knock anything over. Every run is timed and ranked, twenty challenges wait on the same counter, and there are ten thousand grains.

meta.name: The House Before
meta.short_description: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

meta.name: THE LAST STONE
meta.short_description: Up to 100 million stones, one tiny toy shovel and one hidden diamond. Dig, haul and sell stones to afford better gear in this absurd first-person incremental game. Start with a yellow plastic shovel. The diamond could be in your very first successful scoop.

meta.name: Bustbound
meta.short_description: Make 21 your weapon. Bustbound turns blackjack into a roguelike deckbuilder: hit, stand, or double down to win turn-based battles. Combine effect cards and relics, choose your route through six stages, and face the Joker Couple.

meta.name: Kick
meta.short_description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

meta.name: Magic Portals
meta.short_description: A fast, elegant card game of elemental drafting. Draw from the shared Animus, forge crystals, and ignite sleeping portals. Blue attunes, Purple pays, Green multiplies, Yellow improvises. First to seven portals ends the duel - but only the sharpest planner wins. Solo vs AI or online duels.

meta.name: Saraab: Beyond The Veil
meta.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel about healing, where saving your brother means facing your own demons. Elham’s search pulls her through visions and entities rooted in Arabian folklore, and family secrets that should have stayed buried.

meta.name: Survivor Joe Lost Island
meta.short_description: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

meta.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
meta.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

meta.name: Light Source
meta.short_description: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

meta.name: Hexzen
meta.short_description: A hexagonal logic puzzle game set against shifting skies. Use logic alone to read the clues and clear each board. Master a handcrafted campaign, enjoy infinite custom puzzles, and shape your own challenges with the built-in level editor.

meta.name: Ironfields
meta.short_description: A single-player RTS where you capture existing structures instead of building a base from scratch, and success comes more from good decisions than fast reactions.

meta.name: Lots of Axos
meta.short_description: Axolotls are nearly extinct. Your lab is their last hope. Build tanks, hatch axolotls, discover endless variations and help introduce them to new habitats across the globe

meta.name: Path to Power
meta.short_description: Path to Power is a political turn-based strategy game with visual novel elements. Choose your candidate, implement reforms, strike deals, manage resources, contain protests, and pave your way to the pinnacle of power in 1992 Kazakhstan.

meta.name: Midnight Rogues
meta.short_description: Build the sequence that fights for you in this roguelike auto-battler. Buy cards and arrange them across your board, then watch a timer activate them in order. Change their placement to create powerful combinations and take down The City’s corrupted superheroes.

meta.name: Infi-Knight
meta.short_description: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.

meta.name: Traffic Architect
meta.short_description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

meta.name: Legacy Miner
meta.short_description: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.

meta.name: AI Says
meta.short_description: A rage game where you control your character only through an AI chat. No WASD. The AI can't see the deadly test chambers, but you can. Give precise instructions or die trying.

meta.name: ONE LAST BEAM
meta.short_description: Aim your flashlight. Let your weapons fire. Survive escalating zombie hordes in this objective-driven survivor roguelite. Restore the power grid, evolve your arsenal, and reach dawn—but brighter light attracts more danger.

meta.name: 4:12 AM
meta.short_description: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

meta.name: Demon Source
meta.short_description: Demon Source is a soulslike roguelike game with procedural generated dungeons. Try new builds each run. Gather the Source to unlock new items and abilities. Solve the mystery of seven inhabitants of the Church. Try the Ultimate Challenge with great classical music. It is made by one person!

meta.name: Constellations
meta.short_description: Connect the stars to reveal each constellation in a minimalist puzzle game inspired by all 88 real-world constellations. Revisit your discoveries in the Catalogue, play at your own pace and enjoy the journey through an imagined sky.

meta.name: Dead Sector
meta.short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

meta.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
meta.short_description: Tower Defense against massive zombie hordes. Build turrets, defend your tower, and discover roguelite and survivor-like progression.

meta.name: No Sleep Tonight
meta.short_description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

meta.name: Tessera
meta.short_description: A calm, craft-first jigsaw game. Feel every piece: seven interlocking cut styles across four board shapes, including grid, hexagonal, triangular, and organic Voronoi, from a few dozen pieces to 1,000+. Daily puzzles, shareable codes, and curated museum masterworks.

meta.name: PLOW
meta.short_description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

meta.name: Hearts Extreme
meta.short_description: The classic card game Hearts, rebuilt as a solo puzzle. Every level sets a different goal for you to hit. Ten decks, each built from a different set of cards, played at 4, 5 or 6 player tables. And a ranked game where you compete with players around the world.

meta.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
meta.short_description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

meta.name: Entropic Decay
meta.short_description: After being caught up in a mysterious experiment on an alien pathogen brought to earth on a meteor you gain unexpected abilities, but are now property of an unethical mega corporation hell bent on weaponizing the very thing that's keeping you alive. Survive a world falling into Entropic Decay.....

5319550.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex

meta.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
meta.short_description: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

meta.name: HAVKER-MAN X
meta.short_description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

meta.name: 1.44MB RESCUE
meta.short_description: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

meta.name: rest: in a dark room
meta.short_description: Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.

meta.name: NIGHTWARD
meta.short_description: Your mother was a night nurse. A month after her funeral, a hospital closed for twelve years calls your phone. Follow her route through Sislidere, one sealed building at a time, and learn who was kept awake there - and why. Some of them only move when you look away.

meta.name: Main Bastion
meta.short_description: As darkness deepens and monsters emerge from their shadowed dens, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread. Take command of the last bastion! Build cunning traps, merge towers, choose unique upgrade cards, and level up your defenders. Can you hold the walls against dragons and their hordes?

meta.name: Circuit Pulse
meta.short_description: Circuit Pulse is a circuit puzzle game. Route glowing energy through cables and components on a board. Split, merge, and time pulses to power targets and trigger chain reactions across a board of escalating challenges.

meta.name: The Crust
meta.short_description: Build and automate a lunar colony that Earth depends on. Mine regolith, run conveyor-and-drone factories above and below the surface, manage colonists, trade with rival Earth factions — and play a story campaign with multiple endings.

meta.name: DYSMANTLE
meta.short_description: Ascend from your shelter. Ruin everything. Escape the wretched island. ⚔️🔨🎣🌱🌵🍰 Explore. Fight. Level up. Survive. Gather. Craft. Harvest. Hunt. Build. Farm. Solve puzzles. Fish. Cook. Live. Enjoy the bittersweet post-apocalypse.

meta.name: Scam Line
meta.short_description: Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory

meta.name: Opus Magnum
meta.short_description: Opus Magnum is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem, Infinifactory, and SHENZHEN I/O. Design and build machines that assemble potions, poisons, and more using the alchemical engineer’s most advanced tool: the transmutation engine!

200210.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt

spy.developer: Wild Shadow Studios, Deca Live Operations GmbH
spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play

meta.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
meta.short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

meta.name: Wartales
meta.short_description: Wartales is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!

meta.name: Lunacid
meta.short_description: Cast into the Great Well, unwanted by the world above. You delve the dark in search of the Old One, your last salvation. Lunacid is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by Shadow Tower and King’s Field.

meta.name: Is This Seat Taken?
meta.short_description: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

meta.name: Silica
meta.short_description: Silica blends FPS and RTS in epic, photorealistic battles. Choose to fight on the ground or command from above as humans or aliens. Dive into thrilling multiplayer combat or master strategic command. Are you ready to survive and conquer?

meta.name: Let's Build a Zoo
meta.short_description: It's time to Build a Zoo! Construct and decorate enclosures, buy and breed animals, hire zookeepers and vets... then try your hand at DNA splicing, and stitch together over 300,000 different types of animal. This can only go smoothly...

meta.name: Kotama and Academy Citadel
meta.short_description: In the Academy Citadel, strength reigns supreme: only the most powerful survive and thrive. Fight your way through the high-tech Academy in your quest to get the highest of honors for a student, and uncover secrets that can save it in its direst crisis in this 2.5D side-scrolling Metroidvania.

meta.name: Muse Dash
meta.short_description: Paradise of parkour & rhythm game ★★★ — Muse Dash!!

meta.name: Solarpunk™
meta.short_description: Solarpunk is a survival game in a technologically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and hop on your airship to explore distant islands in the sky.

spy.developer: Hollow Ponds, Richard Hogg, Talha Kaya

meta.name: Wilmot Works It Out
meta.short_description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

meta.name: SpaceEngine
meta.short_description: The world's first science-based photorealistic interactive 3D planetarium that models the entire Universe, using procedural generation for uncharted areas.

meta.name: Liftoff®: FPV Drone Racing
meta.short_description: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!

meta.name: Weeping Souls
meta.short_description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

meta.name: Heroes & Co.
meta.short_description: Hire the worst misfits in town and form the perfect team to face every disaster. Your mission? Survive one full week. Get ready for seven days of cascading emergencies, exhausted heroes, and impossible choices to save the day.

meta.name: ERLIK
meta.short_description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

meta.name: Dunjin
meta.short_description: Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

meta.name: Dialshift
meta.short_description: Dialshift is a fast score-chasing arcade game played on one relentless ring. Every turn is also a hit. Read the targets, choose your route, and hold your nerve as seven modes twist the rules.

meta.name: FAIL GAMES
meta.short_description: FAIL GAMES is a collection of brutally hard but simple minigames. Beat each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail and spend them on outfits and effects. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

meta.name: SUPER GAHAKU
meta.short_description: Draw directly in 3D space! Bring topics to life with your own 3D creations. Laugh at the hilarious results and guess what everyone was trying to draw! Imagination matters more than drawing skills. A party game where everyone can shine!

meta.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
meta.short_description: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

meta.name: Code of Shadows
meta.short_description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where you don't just deploy drones, you command them. Switch modes mid-fight, fuse drones into stronger ones, and cut through rift-spawned hordes across collapsing dimensions.

meta.name: Kamikaze Aliens
meta.short_description: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

meta.name: I Hate Scalpers
meta.short_description: I just hate scalpers. So I made a game about bonking them so they don't come back! Figure out who the scalpers and sitters are and BONK THEM! Duel people in Cut The Line and be the hero the city.

meta.name: Goninkan
meta.short_description: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

meta.name: Piratocon: Dig, Restore & Collect
