Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back. Streaming? Name newcomers after your viewers.

meta.name: Cuby Clicker
meta.short_description: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

5396310.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took

meta.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
meta.short_description: Beat a hero. Steal their skill. Turn it on the next one. A hands-on 2D pixel-art action roguelite: 13 heroes, 52 skills to steal and 34 special augments to stack into a broken build. No levels, no XP — only what you take.

meta.name: ZERO VISIBILITY
meta.short_description: Survive one day at a time in a fog-drowned American town overrun by the dead. Scavenge for supplies, get back to base before dark, take in survivors and hold off night raids. Every sound draws them closer. Find five fragments of research data to learn what happened here.

meta.name: Another Cat`s Tale
meta.short_description: A girl named Anna hides in a cursed mansion where the all-knowing Cat brought a fairy tale with no ending. He is patiently waiting for someone to finish it. In this first-person adventure, Anna must explore the mansion, solve puzzles, fight, and finally uncover its secrets.

meta.name: LINE WARLORD
meta.short_description: A real-time lane-defense roguelite. Spend rations to send troops down the line, stack relics, promote your units, and break the enemy stronghold with a different army every run.

meta.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
meta.short_description: A casual Texas Hold’em game with solo runs and online play for 2–8 players on Steam. One-time purchase, no paid chip top-ups. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

meta.name: Unpredictable Cake
meta.short_description: A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

5045430.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn

meta.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
meta.short_description: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.

meta.name: 魔女牌Witch Card‌
meta.short_description: As a Witch Intern, you will engage in card duel exams with the two witch examiners Little Red Riding Hood and Alice, using your starting deck, treasure cards, passive skills and divination. You need to clear 10 floors to become an official witch.

meta.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
meta.short_description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

meta.name: Continuum
meta.short_description: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

meta.name: Voxotron
meta.short_description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

meta.name: Zukontide
meta.short_description: Swarm-scale tower defense: up to 40,000 aliens per siege, thousands on screen, physically crushing into your chokepoints. You are expected to fall — every kill banks credits, even in defeat. Grind the war economy, research deadlier guns, mount them on the ruins, and return to hold the line.

meta.name: Overtime : Development Hell
meta.short_description: Play as Frank, a developer at a highly secretive game development studio rushing to finish the studio's most anticipated release, while being disrupted by an obsessed fan trying to gain information on the long awaited game. Survive Frank's final night alone in this Psychological Horror experience.

meta.name: Novalex Project Zero
meta.short_description: A turn-based car-company tycoon. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, undercut on price, and out-engineer a field that grows to 30 AI rivals across a century of motoring. Build the carmaker that lasts, or go bankrupt trying.

meta.name: Moon Swarm
meta.short_description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

meta.name: Coverage
meta.short_description: Grow to cover the board with your pieces--or absorb all of your opponent's. A board game similar to Othello and Ataxx, playable by up to 2 players online or offline, with a built-in board editor and 3 game modes! Relax with a classic experience or try a fast-paced simultaneous movement mode!

meta.name: Trust Me, It Binds
meta.short_description: A procedural deckbuilder where you build real molecules and sell increasingly questionable confidence. Play cards, chase the target, stack absurd bonuses, and turn strange chemistry into an irresistible valuation. Nobody really understands molecules. Fortunately everyone understands numbers.

meta.name: Nonet Concerto R
meta.short_description: Blast through hordes of monsters with magic in this third-person 3D loot action game. Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and take on 50+ stages solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Stream on Twitch or YouTube and your viewers' chat can trigger monster reinforcements and storms.

meta.name: Dark Alley
meta.short_description: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

meta.name: Moto Rogue
meta.short_description: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

meta.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
meta.short_description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

meta.name: Spring Breeze Shokudo
meta.short_description: 1978, southern Taiwan. Come home to reopen your grandmother's shuttered shokudo: shop the morning market, set the menu, hire staff and win the street back from the flashy restaurant across the road. Currently available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese only.

meta.name: KPOP Idol Factory
meta.short_description: Form your own K-pop group – and live through fresh drama every day. Scout talent, plan training and comebacks, battle rivals on a 3D stage and make choices that change careers. It doesn't end at debut: your story runs through three acts all the way to the world tour.

meta.name: Nova Survivors
meta.short_description: Blast through endless alien hordes in space and climb the Steam leaderboards. Pick from 21 ships, each with its own weapon and ultimate, stack cards and weapon evolutions, and push through a 100-level campaign or endless Survival until your build breaks the game.

meta.name: Build A Bot
meta.short_description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

meta.name: Tzelem
meta.short_description: The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.

meta.name: Ragdoll Robotics
meta.short_description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

meta.name: Rosavane Borers LLC
meta.short_description: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

meta.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
meta.short_description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! meta.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
meta.short_description: A binary decision-driven city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

meta.name: Table Of Truth
meta.short_description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

meta.name: Faraway
meta.short_description: Faraway is an endless procedurally generated, mastery-driven arcade game about a shooting star that creates constellations to stay alive.

meta.name: Rogue Belt
meta.short_description: Fight through a storm-wracked asteroid belt in this top-down space roguelite, solo or in online co-op. Mix ships and weapons, choose an upgrade every minute, and face the boss after ten minutes. Break through to unlock new ships, weapons, and permanent upgrades.

meta.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS

meta.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
meta.short_description: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

meta.name: Chivalware
meta.short_description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

meta.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
meta.short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

meta.name: The Cruel Guardians
meta.short_description: Your manor is threatened from every side by brigands, anarchist revolutionaries, and a demigod. Will you resort to forbidden magic or pray for divine aid? An interactive fantasy novel, 181,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

meta.name: Soar Up The Charts
meta.short_description: A fast-paced rhythm game and arcade-style rail shooter where music is your weapon! 🎸With tracks provided by Alden Ave and Keep Flying, be ready to turn it up and blast your way through those radio robots! 🎺

meta.name: Performance Review: Survivor
meta.short_description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

meta.name: Last Inspection

meta.name: PHUY
meta.short_description: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

meta.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
meta.short_description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

meta.name: MUPO
meta.short_description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

meta.name: Sheepscape

meta.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡

meta.name: Little Lands

meta.name: PeeVPee

meta.name: Fablery

meta.name: March and Conquer

meta.name: Cardalaxy
meta.short_description: 4X distilled into a card game with 5 different ways to win.

meta.name: REC:REWIND

meta.name: The Staring Man | 凝視男

meta.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows

meta.name: Pidgeon Pocket

meta.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
meta.short_description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

meta.name: Picronix 2

meta.name: Fraga

meta.name: Score Circuit

meta.name: Gotching

meta.name: Gilded Shoals

meta.name: Menthal
meta.short_description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

meta.name: Mini Battleships

meta.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid

meta.name: ICEY

meta.name: Nocturnal 2

meta.name: Soundway

meta.name: Physics Clicker

meta.name: Working95

meta.name: Heroinu
meta.short_description: Simple is the Beast.

meta.name: Ghost Express

meta.name: Tape Man

meta.name: GAEKGWI

meta.name: A Bun Above

meta.name: 모야이게임

5115730.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill

meta.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
meta.short_description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

meta.name: 異界ノ宿帳

meta.name: The Cozy Funemployment

meta.name: Dream Glitcher

meta.name: Hell is Neon Colored

meta.name: ROBOTEKA
meta.short_description: A unique robot fighting action game built around simple controls, precise timing, and martial arts-inspired combat.

meta.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer
meta.short_description: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.

meta.name: PegLotto!

meta.name: Roadweave

meta.name: Xiqiao Chronicles

5045380.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive

meta.name: Nana's Game Dev Diary
meta.short_description: Nana's Game Dev Diary is a relaxing life sim about making games. Join Nana in her cozy little home as she follows her dream, planning each day around development, learning, part-time work, and rest. Enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life with Nana.

meta.name: RADZIMA
meta.short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

meta.name: Gnat Pack
meta.short_description: A short incremental game about feeding a swarm of hungry gnats. Guide your bugs to the fruit, and unlock upgrades to grow your pack of buzzing buddies one bite at a time.

meta.name: Bottle Flip Inc
meta.short_description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

spy.genre: Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access

meta.name: Age of Me
meta.short_description: An idle civilization game for desktop and mobile. From your first settlement to distant worlds, every discovery brings a new possibility. Build, research, and expand in an idle game designed for desktop and mobile, with offline production that keeps your civilization growing between visits.

meta.name: La Muraille 1806
meta.short_description: A Napoleonic-era Roguelite Tower Defense. Lead the defense of the Wall against the hordes of the apocalypse. Command the united armies of Europe, deploy living lines of defense, map out range cards, and halt tens of thousands of enemies. Ready! Present! Fire! Commander, win humanity one more dawn.

meta.name: Punch Riot
meta.short_description: A first-person party brawler for up to 20 players! Punch rivals out of crumbling arenas or launch them into goals with wacky weapons. Play every mode solo against AI, or invite Steam friends. Multiplayer starts with 2 human players, with AI filling empty slots.

meta.name: Bullet Glory
meta.short_description: A neon arena score-attack shooter. Clear bullet storms, unlock 12 ships with distinct specials, team up in local co-op, and study leaderboard replays to push your score higher.

meta.name: Memento Resonance
meta.short_description: Forge a Resonance with enemy monsters and welcome them into your party. Equip their skills with relics to shape your own battle style, then climb an ever-changing tower as you follow the trail of lost memories in this monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game.

meta.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator
meta.short_description: Buy rusty motorcycles, restore every part, add custom paint and decals, then take them for a test ride and sell them for a profit. Turn barn finds into superbikes and grow your small garage into the best dealership in town.

meta.name: Sitter
meta.short_description: Investigating his grandmother's mysterious death, a detective enters her home in search of the truth. But the house begins to toy with him. Space twists, fears take shape, and there's no way out. Every step, every room, every loop brings him closer to madness.

meta.name: Night Stocker
meta.short_description: Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits. The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.

meta.name: Loadpath
meta.short_description: LOADPATH is a physics-driven demolition game about finding the supports that matter. Cut through industrial structures, trigger massive collapses, recover Salvage, upgrade your demolition rig and descend deeper through seven increasingly dangerous sites.

meta.name: Million Blocks
meta.short_description: Destroy exactly one million blocks in this minimalist black-and-white idle clicker. Click or automate, upgrade six endless branches, prestige, evolve, and climb the tier system

meta.name: Quarterheart
meta.short_description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

meta.name: The Lifeline
meta.short_description: To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it? Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

spy.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play

meta.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
meta.short_description: Take your first steps on Mars and face the challenge of surviving alone on the Red Planet. Build your first shelter, secure vital resources, grow food, research new technologies, and explore the hostile Martian landscape. Your survival starts here.

meta.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
meta.short_description: A cozy organization simulator in a dream: sort 6344 cubic animals, 120 unique species onto the right shelves. Turn a chaotic dream into a perfectly organized collection.

meta.name: BAD STUDENT LOVE
meta.short_description: Labeled a “troublemaker,” you transfer to the worst high school. There, you become entangled in dangerous relationships driven by desire, jealousy, and manipulation. Will you get closer, be used, or get hurt— your choices will determine how your story with them ends.

meta.name: Wrestle Bounce Online
meta.short_description: Hold. Release. BONK! A one-button ragdoll physics wrestling game where the first head to hit the mat loses. Duel a friend on one keyboard, beat the AI, win tournaments or take on real players online for coin prizes. Easy to learn, impossible to play without laughing.

meta.name: Taise-CityVsBus
meta.short_description: This city has been swallowed by apocalyptic chaos. The crew entered the streets before you and are still fighting. You are the bus driver. Drive through the city and rescue the scattered crew in this exhilarating apocalyptic bus action game!

meta.name: Bloodlines & Banners
meta.short_description: A historical 4X where you rule a dynasty, not just an empire. 90 civilizations across ten eras of real history on a hex map of Earth. Your rulers age and die; the heir you raised inherits their traits, their rivalries, and your bloodline's standing.

meta.name: Deskpot
meta.short_description: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

meta.name: Wizzy the Wood
meta.short_description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play

meta.name: Quarantine Zombies - Prologue 2
meta.short_description: The prologue continues with new exclusive quests and a deadly dungeon. Survive the first 6 days in post-apocalyptic Chicago, where FPS action meets quarantine inspection. Repair your car and fight your way to the main checkpoint to save your younger brother. The army arrives in 30 days.

meta.name: MUTARIUM: Mutant Aquarium Defense
meta.short_description: Feed them and they mutate. Overfeed them and they turn on you. Mix MEAT, GLOW and ORE to grow your fish into adorable little horrors, then let them fight the failed experiments breaking into your tank. You never control a unit — what you feed is the whole strategy.

meta.name: Fish Market Tidy Up!
meta.short_description: A squall has scattered the morning catch across an old harbour fish market. Put every fish back in its crate: each one you sort plays a note, every full crate sings its tune. A cozy first-person tidying game with a living hall, hidden curiosities and upgrades.

meta.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
meta.short_description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

meta.name: 10 Second Mixtape
meta.short_description: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

meta.name: Toll Idle
meta.short_description: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

meta.name: ChromaFlow
meta.short_description: Build a factory powered by color. Extract red, green, and blue, route them through conveyor networks, and mix them into an expanding spectrum. Fulfil requests for the Chroma Core, unlock new technology, and optimize every production line.

meta.name: Bar Owner Simulator
meta.short_description: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

meta.name: Apex Armada
meta.short_description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

meta.name: Your Sweet Little Kitty
meta.short_description: Your cozy desktop companion! This adorable cat hangs out on your screen while you work or study, gently reminding you to hydrate and take breaks. Feed it to unlock cute animations and level up your bond. Ready to be the ultimate cat servant?

meta.name: King Dies Rich
meta.short_description: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

meta.name: Refund Me TD 2
meta.short_description: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

meta.name: Fish Battle Champion
meta.short_description: A strategic fishing roguelike autobattler with 'fish deckbuilding'. Catch bizarre fish, discover rare bonuses, collect powerful items and build unexpected synergies. Every night, send your team into the tournament and see if your strategy survives!

meta.name: InCowMental
meta.short_description: InCowMental is a cute and colorful tiny incremental game where you collect milk from your cows to sell it and make cheese. Upgrade your farm, and between upgrades, play mini-games to boost your production and sales!

meta.name: The Totemist
meta.short_description: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.

meta.name: Harvest Together
meta.short_description: Build a cozy farm with friends or solo! Grow crops, raise animals, and ride your horse across the meadows. Dynamic weather waters your crops when it rains and blankets your farm in winter snow. Online co-op for up to 4 players — sow together, grow together.

meta.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
meta.short_description: Scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear apocalypse incremental game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

meta.name: Moonbased
meta.short_description: Fuse any two of 23 weapons into 422 absurd, screen-clearing turrets in this chaotic top-down lunar roguelite! Pilot 4 hulls across 4 alien worlds, stack broken upgrades, melt massive bosses and survive escalating swarms to top the weekly leaderboard!

meta.name: Desktop Ball
meta.short_description: A little ball that lives on top of your desktop and can blow it up, zap it, flood it, haunt it, or grow a garden all over it. Fidget with it through meetings, queues and compiles, and when you're done, it gets out of the way. Seven weird balls, and every one of them beats doomscrolling.

meta.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft
meta.short_description: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a toilet-humour clicker set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make dookie, build ten ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet.

meta.name: Tick & Tired
meta.short_description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

4832420.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes

meta.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
meta.short_description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

meta.name: FAKE ME
meta.short_description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

meta.name: Flock Fight
meta.short_description: A minimalist couch fighting game with a twist: you are a flock of health units. Balance offense and defense as you use weapons to survive quick match ups online or locally.

meta.name: Flea Madness
meta.short_description: Jump into shooter where armed fleas fight over objectives with guns, bites, and rideable insects. Capture points, support your allies, and cause complete chaos using a mix of firearms, hilarious bite attacks, and strange insect companions that can carry you into battle.

meta.name: Build Christmas
meta.short_description: Decorate a cozy North Pole village for Christmas. String lights on rooftops, trees, bridges and trains, and fill the snow with festive decorations. Underneath runs a light production sim: keep the elf workshops making presents and get the sleighs loaded before Christmas Eve.

meta.name: Hit or Die
meta.short_description: Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors, dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing wins.

meta.name: Lanternborn
meta.short_description: ▎ The city of Caldera froze one minute before midnight, and the Hollows came out of the dark. Carry the last light through ever-changing streets, light the lamps, break the Bells and decide how the longest night ends. A dark-fantasy action roguelite with a story.

meta.name: Rolls and Dungeons
meta.short_description: An incremental game about casinos and dungeons! Assemble a team of debtor-heroes, clear dungeons, hoard chips, and spin the slot machine in combat to defeat monsters and bosses. Level up your luck, hunt for loot and artifacts, unlock new dungeon levels – the ultimate jackpot awaits at the very end!

meta.name: Disaster Scenario
meta.short_description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

meta.name: From Zero: Idle Factory
meta.short_description: Start with one machine and grow across five factories in this idle/incremental game. Build production chains, research better parts and reinvest your profits. Find the bottleneck, choose your next upgrade and work toward a final goal.

meta.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
meta.short_description: Build robots, equip factories and defend your headquarters in a strategy auto-battler. Collect parts, refine your army and take on Campaign, Endless Solo, co-op Duo or a Duel with a friend.

meta.name: UPSHOT
meta.short_description: Every hit splits them. Every split makes it worse. UPSHOT is a 1–4 player arena shooter where bouncing balls keep breaking into smaller, faster ones. Clear room after room against the clock, open mystery gift boxes and take down a giant boss every fifth room, solo or in co-op.

meta.name: Puzzle Duel: Animal Gem Battle
meta.short_description: Click gems in order to unleash skills! Puzzle Duel is a fast 1v1 battle where puzzles meet fighting games. Build your skill deck, pick a cute animal fighter, knock rivals into the air with ultimates, and climb the ranked ladder in 45-second matches.

meta.name: Brain Party
meta.short_description: Brain Party is a multiplayer puzzle party game. Compete online with other players for first place by total score. Unlock higher difficulties and beat your personal bests in solo challenges, or take on fresh daily challenges and climb the global leaderboard.

meta.name: Under the Aurora
meta.short_description: A mystery quest exploring life, death, and the path to return.

meta.name: TapTrapGrow
meta.short_description: Light up a pest-filled garden, send turtle shells ricocheting and protect your cakes. Turn short hunts into permanent upgrades and elemental chain reactions in this arcade incremental game, then take on a six-boss finale.

meta.name: Below The Blades
meta.short_description: Climb, repair and survive Turbine 46 in a first-person horror game where every handhold matters. Survive a violent storm, manage your grip and stamina, and uncover what happened to the technician who came before you while trying not to get caught by what's crawling around the turbine.

meta.name: Grazed - Incremental Arcade
meta.short_description: Every kill means brushing past death. Grazed is a skill-based incremental arcade game: graze enemies with your blades, build your combo, and ignite absurd powers. Runs last seconds to minutes. Beat your score, upgrade, repeat.

meta.name: ALL EYES ON ME
meta.short_description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play co-op locally or online, or join online conquests.

meta.name: Keystones: Foundations
meta.short_description: Grab, slide, rotate and tumble stone pieces as a little slime in a 3D puzzle game. Match faces, rearrange supports and plan your next foothold across 100 campaign levels, each with five difficulty variants.

5133230.name: Can You Beat The AI God?

meta.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
meta.short_description: Can You Beat The AI God? is an action-packed bullet-heaven roguelite. Survive endless swarms of robotic enemies, unlock devastating synergies, and upgrade your abilities. Test your limits and see if you can defeat the ultimate AI God!

meta.name: FLOWFALL Inertia
meta.short_description: One long fall through neon, music and motion. Morph your glowing shape through gates timed to an original soundtrack, choose your route where the shaft splits, and chase FLOW until the whole world lights up. Race up to three friends online, or sink into it alone.

meta.name: LITTLE KNIGHT: HOMECOMING
meta.short_description: Return home as a little knight, rescue your neighbors and rebuild your raided village. A storybook 2D action game where combos, charged strikes, rolls and parries carry you through 16 boss fights.

meta.name: Spin Tactics
meta.short_description: A roguelike strategy game inside a slot machine. Pick your Companions, set the order they fire in, change your symbols with Gems, and build an engine that keeps growing, until the machine is wonderfully broken and the bosses can’t keep up. No real-money gambling.

meta.name: The Traitor's Anvil
meta.short_description: A pixel art roguelite auto battler about a framed royal blacksmith. Smelt, hammer and assemble every weapon and armor by hand, arm five heroes and a rebel squad, set their formation, then lead them across five lands to topple the usurper king. Forge all 40 legends.

meta.name: The Coin Keeper : Tidy up !
meta.short_description: One dragon sneeze. 6,000 mixed-up coins. Your holiday cancelled. Explore a fantasy museum, inspect coins and find their rightful places in this first-person sorting game. Unlock skills and magical powers to turn a glorious mess into a perfectly organised collection.

meta.name: Unfair Flips
meta.short_description: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

meta.name: The Spike Cross
meta.short_description: "The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?" Developed by an indie developer who loves volleyball! The sports game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

meta.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
meta.short_description: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

meta.name: Evitania Online - Idle RPG

meta.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE
meta.short_description: Guide a cute, drifting sunfish through an underwater cave in this 2D side-scrolling action game. Dodge rocks, rubbish, shells, anemones, fish and charging orcas. Ride powerful currents, beat your best distance, and retry instantly when one collision ends your run.

meta.name: Overhours
meta.short_description: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!

meta.name: Best Streamer
meta.short_description: A ruthless streamer simulation where you'll do anything to reach the top. Grow legally with content or eliminate rivals with weapons. Manage survival needs, use illegal tactics to crush the competition, evade the police, and become the world's number one streamer

meta.name: 世界傳記
meta.short_description: Fantasy RPG that features AP turn-based combat and various RPG nurturing elements, while also offering rich and diverse character storylines that grip the heart.

meta.name: Desktop Claw Master

5490150.name: PARTNERS IN PANIC - asymmetric CO-OP driving game

meta.name: PARTNERS IN PANIC - asymmetric CO-OP driving game

meta.name: KNURLWORM

meta.name: Black Market INC.

meta.name: Malignus

meta.name: Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt
meta.short_description: Restore the lost treasures of Ancient Egypt in a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience. Every artifact is shattered into a unique arrangement of fragments, offering endless replayability across multiple difficulty levels, from casual sessions to expert challenges.

meta.name: 疾风群侠传

meta.name: Bust Out

meta.name: Netherwake
meta.short_description: Netherwake is a story-driven first-person psychological horror game. Explore a town consumed by unnatural fog and a facility beneath the mountain. Hide from deadly anomalies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what happened before they find you.

5300620.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest

meta.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest

meta.name: ASAGE

meta.name: HANDS OVER
meta.short_description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

meta.name: CRED

spy.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play

meta.name: Idle Legend
meta.short_description: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.

meta.name: Door Code

meta.name: Altertum
meta.short_description: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.

5029940.name: The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty

meta.name: The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty
meta.short_description: A Japanese mystery adventure where any of the four could be the killer. Holding the dead man's will, you stay in his estate until the seventh-day memorial. meta.name: Guild of Champions
meta.short_description: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.

meta.name: Ascension Tournament

meta.name: Vroomity Loops

5485060.name: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game

meta.name: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
meta.short_description: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. meta.name: Kinetile

meta.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院
meta.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

meta.name: Hellterns
meta.short_description: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

meta.name: Alph Last Bastion
meta.short_description: The bug swarm is coming, and your bastion is the last thing standing in its way. Build a fortress of turrets anywhere on the battlefield, power it up, and hold the line against relentless hordes and monstrous bosses. Fall, upgrade your arsenal, and return stronger.

meta.name: Stadt Land Fluss with friends
meta.short_description: Stadt, Land, Fluss für euren nächsten Online-Spieleabend: Ob Stadt, Land, Serienfigur oder Fund im WG-Kühlschrank, wählt klassische Kategorien oder denkt euch eigene aus. Stell dein Wissen auch allein auf die Probe und finde immer neue Begriffe in abwechslungsreichen Spielmodi.

meta.name: Beauty Store Tidy Up Together
meta.short_description: Organize mountains of cosmetics, arrange beautiful displays, and create the perfect beauty store! Relax and tidy up solo or with up to 4 players in this cozy first-person organizing simulator.

meta.name: Inkturn
meta.short_description: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.

meta.name: MAZRAP

meta.name: Outralism

meta.name: A.N.S.I.A.

meta.name: Ares Program

meta.name: So Many Cats!

meta.name: Mimania

meta.name: Time For Changes

meta.name: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden

meta.name: Minesweeper Quest

meta.name: Save the Sandcastle

meta.name: Free Company

meta.name: The Friendly Monster
meta.short_description: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?

meta.name: Choo chop

meta.name: Business Tycoon

666. The devil has spoken. She wants you to roll the dice. Why? Nobody knows. She needs a six. Then maybe another. Then maybe 666. A short dice rolling game: throw, buy upgrades that bend the odds, and keep rolling until she gets what she wants.
